# Markmap Generator

Curated by Skill Harbor — a skill that turns ideas into fully interactive, zoomable HTML mind maps on the user's own machine: translate the idea into a strict markdown outline (H1 as root node, sentence-case nodes), save it to the skill's diagrams/ folder, compile it with the bundled Node build script (markmap-cli), and hand over a standalone HTML file to open in the browser — zoom, collapse and expand branches. No API keys, no third-party plugins. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @smartbrainactivity. Honest caveats: needs Node.js and the skill's bundled build script to run; some paths in the SKILL.md are Windows-centric (C:\Users\...) — adapt them on macOS/Linux; the output is a standalone HTML file, not an editable diagram source you can round-trip. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
